sourceText:
Hummous
By: Thecoffeebreak
Published: Tuesday, July 13, 2010 - 1:33pm

Ingredients




400 grams can of chickpeas
60 milliliters liquid from can of chickpeas
2 tablespoons tahini
1 garlic clove, minced
5 tablespoons of lemon juice, or more if required
1 teaspoon of cumin
Salt, pepper to taste
3 tablespoons of olive oil
1/2 teaspoon of paprika
1 tablespoon of chopped parsley to garnish

Preparation

1 Drain chickpeas and set aside liquid from can. 2 Place chickpeas, liquid, tahini, garlic, lemon juice and cumin to a food processor or blender. Blend for 3-5 minutes or until smooth and well combined. Season with salt and pepper. 3 Transfer to a serving bowl; create a shallow well in the centre of the hummus and add olive oil. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley.

About


Hummus is one of the favourite dip in the Middle East.  Usually served with toasted pita bread or with vegetable crudités and makes very good and healthy appetizer or a snack.
